reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Joe D
reviews.text: Wayne's Tree Service is awesome! They took out a huge elm tree that was looming over the house. You can tell they take pride in their service and their workmanship. Very reasonable rates. If you need tree service in the Washington area, you'll be happy you chose Wayne's.

reviews.author: Jeff Laugle
reviews.text: Best tree service customer service I’ve ever received!!! And, at a great price!! I will use them again! Saw their giant monopole billboard and called the number, left a message. Same day, Wayne II called me back to schedule a walkthrough. I’ve just purchased a home near Bath, NC and it had several trees needing to be removed. Never met in-person until after the job was complete, so all the set up amounted to a few phone calls and confirmation of which trees I had marked. A couple days after the initial phone message, he walked the property and confirmed the work. A few days later they performed the work. He always kept me up to date on the plan, their availability, and when the job started and they finished. As a cost comparison, in VB, VA, I needed 3 smaller trees removed and stumps ground. It was $7,500 for those 3 trees, and they filled the holes mostly with the grinding. For Wayne’s work, I had 9 trees, 4 of them bigger around than 2 of me could reach around, danger close to power lines and my barn. They completed the work in about 5 hours or so. Stumps ground and filled with soil not chips, hauled away what couldn’t be chipped, left my property in great shape. His price for the 9 large trees was LESS THAN what I paid for 3 smaller trees! And the work was harder to execute. I will use them again. I highly recommend their service!

reviews.author: Chris G
reviews.text: Wayne’s Tree Service was trimming my neighbor’s trees and I asked them to take down two damaged trees and a snag in my yard. The work was excellent! Trees were removed, stumps were ground and clean up was very thorough and detailed. All at a fair price. I will definitely call them whenever I need their services and highly recommended them to anyone needing tree work.
